english: Me? The name's Stillwell. I can see the past, present, and future. All at once. It's a lot.
french: Moi ? Tu peux m'appeler Stillwell. Je vois le passé, le présent et l'avenir. Tout en même temps. Ça fait beaucoup.
russian: Я? Меня зовут Стиллвелл. Я вижу прошлое, настоящее и будущее. Одновременно. Да, это непросто.
bulgarian: Me? The name's Stillwell. I can see the past, present, and future. All at once. It's a lot.

english: I've come to Mistria on urgent business...
french: Passe me voir si tu veux que je te dise la $bonne aventure$. J'essaierai d'avoir l'air aussi surpris que toi.
russian: Заходи, когда захочешь, чтобы я прочитал твою $судьбу$. Я постараюсь выглядеть удивленно, когда ты придёшь.
bulgarian: I've come to Mistria on urgent business...

english: Hey [Ari]. Hmm? No, we haven't met before.
french: Bonjour, [Ari]. Comment ? Non, c'est bien la première fois qu'on se rencontre.
russian: Приветствую, [Ari]. Хмм? Нет, мы раньше не встречались.
bulgarian: Hey [Ari]. Hmm? No, we haven't met before.

english: I'm closing up, but the third eye is always open for you, [Ari].
french: Je ferme boutique, mais mon troisième œil reste toujours ouvert pour toi, [Ari].
bulgarian: Вече е време да затварям, но Третото око винаги е отворено. Поне за теб, [Ari].

english: Breaking down the booth is such a hassle... why is everything so heavy...
french: Le démontage du stand est une telle corvée. Pourquoi tout est aussi lourd ?
bulgarian: Уф, как мразя да прибирам сергията... Защо всичко е толкова тежко...

english: Fate has decreed... that I pack up my booth...
french: Le destin a voulu... que je démonte mon stand...
bulgarian: Съдбата повелява... Да прибера сергията...

english: I'm too sleepy to do booth breakdown... help...
french: J'ai trop sommeil pour démonter le stand... Au secours !
bulgarian: Толкова ми се спи, че не мога да прибера сергията... Помогни ми...

english: Well, be sure to find your way home... before fate intervenes...
french: N'oublie pas de rentrer chez toi... avant que le destin ne s'en mêle...
bulgarian: Хм, прибирай се, преди съдбата да се намеси...

english: You're up late, [Ari]... how do you have so much energy?
french: Tu es encore debout à cette heure-là, [Ari]... Où trouves-tu toute cette énergie ?
bulgarian: Будуваш до късно, [Ari]... Откъде намираш толкова енергия...?

english: But sometimes seeing them simply means it's time to go home.
french: Mais parfois, les voir signifie seulement qu'il est temps de rentrer chez soi.
bulgarian: Но може би просто означават, че е станало късно и трябва да се прибереш.

english: The stars can have many hidden meanings...
french: Les étoiles peuvent avoir de nombreuses significations cachées...
bulgarian: Звездите крият толкова много значения...

english: I inherited these robes, and this booth from my grandmother... they don't make mythical tents like this anymore.
french: Ce manteau et ce stand sont un héritage de ma grand-mère... on ne fabrique plus de tentes mythiques comme celles-ci, de nos jours.
bulgarian: Тази роба и тази сергия са ми завещани от баба ми... В днешно време не можеш да намериш такава мистична шатра.

english: Sigh. Better get packed up.
french: Soupir. Je ferais mieux de remballer.
bulgarian: Уф. Май просто трябва да си събера багажа...

english: Nora said I couldn't leave my booth here until next Saturday Market, even if I sleep behind the table...
french: Nora m'a dit que je ne pouvais pas laisser mon stand ici jusqu'au marché de samedi prochain, même si je dormais derrière la table...
bulgarian: Нора каза, че не мога да оставя сергията тук до следващия съботен пазар,\nдори да спя зад масата...

english: I'd be impressed if it wasn't so annoying.
french: Ce serait impressionnant si ça n'était pas si pénible.
bulgarian: I'd be impressed if it wasn't so annoying.

english: Everytime Seridia comes to my booth, she starts saying what I'm about to say, right before I say it.
french: Chaque fois que Seridia vient à mon stand, dès qu'elle ouvre la bouche, elle se met à dire exactement les paroles que j'allais prononcer, mais juste avant moi.
bulgarian: Everytime Seridia comes to my booth, she starts saying what I'm about to say, right before I say it.

english: Thank you, [Ari]... for showing me that the future is not always written.
french: Merci, [Ari]... de m'avoir montré que le futur n'était pas toujours écrit d'avance.
bulgarian: Thank you, [Ari]... for showing me that the future is not always written.

english: A birthday gift? I didn't see any sign of this!
french: Un cadeau d'anniversaire ? Je n'en avais perçu aucun signe annonciateur !
bulgarian: A birthday gift? I didn't see any sign of this!

english: Thanks... I think?
french: Merci... je suppose ?
bulgarian: Thanks... I think?

english: Thank you [Ari]. I see that your intuition has revealed what I like.
french: Merci, [Ari]. Je vois que ton intuition t'a révélé ce qui me plaisait.
bulgarian: Thank you [Ari]. I see that your intuition has revealed what I like.

english: I never expect others to know my tastes, but this is quite to my liking. Thank you, [Ari].
french: Je ne m'attends jamais à ce que d'autres connaissent mes goûts, mais cela me plaît beaucoup. Merci, [Ari].
bulgarian: I never expect others to know my tastes, but this is quite to my liking. Thank you, [Ari].

english: The crystalline seems so unreal... and yet, it reminds us of the natural order of things. Thank you for this wisdom, [Ari].
french: Cette transparence semble irréelle... pourtant, elle nous rappelle l'ordre naturel des choses. Merci pour cette sagesse, [Ari].
bulgarian: The crystalline seems so unreal... and yet, it reminds us of the natural order of things. Thank you for this wisdom, [Ari].

english: There's something about this that defies the cosmic order... I like it.
french: Il y a là-dedans quelque chose qui défie l'ordre du cosmos... ça me plaît.
bulgarian: There's something about this that defies the cosmic order... I like it.

english: The night, the moon, the stars, and the mysteries therein... all of these spark my interest. Thank you, [Ari].
french: La nuit, la lune, les étoiles et les mystères qu'elles recèlent... tout cela attise mon intérêt. Merci, [Ari].
bulgarian: The night, the moon, the stars, and the mysteries therein... all of these spark my interest. Thank you, [Ari].

english: A surprise...? Now that's rare. I love it, [Ari].
french: Une surprise... ? Voilà qui est rare. Merci, je l'adore, [Ari].
bulgarian: A surprise...? Now that's rare. I love it, [Ari].

english: Ah... could it really be?
french: Ah... serait-ce... ?
bulgarian: Ah... could it really be?

english: I foresaw that a figure would come before me, and here you are. What I did not foresee was the depth of your generosity. I thank you, [Ari].
french: J'ai vu qu'une silhouette allait se présenter devant moi et te voici. Ce que je n'avais pas vu, c'est ta profonde générosité. Merci, [Ari].
bulgarian: I foresaw that a figure would come before me, and here you are. What I did not foresee was the depth of your generosity. I thank you, [Ari].

english: Ah yes, one of my favorite foods, replete with the tartness of melancholy. This is exquisite. Thank you.
french: Ah oui, l'un de mes aliments préférés, au goût amer de la mélancolie. C'est délicieux. Merci.
bulgarian: Ah yes, one of my favorite foods, replete with the tartness of melancholy. This is exquisite. Thank you.

english: This thing, this object of mystery... I adore it, [Ari], and long will I contemplate it. Thank you.
french: Cette chose, cet objet plein de mystère... Je l'adore, [Ari], et je le contemplerai longtemps. Merci.
bulgarian: This thing, this object of mystery... I adore it, [Ari], and long will I contemplate it. Thank you.

english: I love it.
french: J'adore ça.
bulgarian: I love it.

english: There's something... unsettling about this.
french: Il y a là-dedans quelque chose de... perturbant.
bulgarian: There's something... unsettling about this.

english: Ah, thank you.
french: Ah, merci.
bulgarian: Ah, thank you.

english: The future always seems a little more bearable with a good glass of wine. Thank you, [Ari].
french: L'avenir semble toujours un peu plus supportable avec un bon verre de vin. Merci, [Ari].
bulgarian: The future always seems a little more bearable with a good glass of wine. Thank you, [Ari].

english: The only thing worse than receiving this gift was knowing it was coming.
french: La seule chose qui soit pire que ce cadeau, c'est de savoir que j'allais le recevoir.
bulgarian: The only thing worse than receiving this gift was knowing it was coming.
